license_required.quote: No person shall act as or claim to be a type of contractor that this chapter licenses unless that person holds or has been assigned a license issued pursuant to this chapter for the type of contractor that person is acting as or claiming to be.

name.quote: There is hereby created within the department of commerce, the Ohio construction industry licensing board

type.quote: The board shall have an administrative section and three specialty sections: a plumbing and hydronics section, an electrical section, and a heating, ventilating, air conditioning, and refrigeration section.

exams.name: Contractor examination (trade-specific)
exams.notes: Each specialty section designs the examination for the type of contractor it licenses. Applicant must pass within the twelve months preceding application. Applicant may retake no sooner than 60 days after most recent attempt; after 5 failures must reapply before retaking.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Ohio Construction Industry Licensing Board specialty section)
exams.quote: when an applicant for licensure as a contractor in a licensed trade meets the qualifications set forth in division (B), (C), or (D) of this section and passes the required examination

interval_years.quote: All licenses a contractor holds pursuant to this chapter shall expire annually on the same date

required.quote: A requirement that an individual who holds any number of valid and unexpired licenses accrue a total of ten hours of continuing education courses per year

hours_per_period.quote: a total of ten hours of continuing education courses per year

period_years.quote: a total of ten hours of continuing education courses per year

value: up to 5 hours per year in specific course requirements per specialty section curriculum
topical_requirements.quote: No curriculum may require more than five hours per year in specific course requirements. No contractor may be required to take more than ten hours per year in continuing education courses.

available.quote: When a written reciprocity agreement between the states exists, and an individual who is registered, licensed, or certified in another state applies to the appropriate specialty section of the Ohio construction industry licensing board submits a copy of the reciprocity agreement, and pays the licensure fee determined pursuant to section 4740.09 of the Revised Code, the appropriate specialty section of the board shall authorize the administrative section to issue, without examination, a license to that individual

requirements.value: Written reciprocity agreement between states must exist; the other state's requirements must be substantially equal to Ohio's; the other state must extend similar reciprocity to Ohio licensees; applicant pays the licensure fee.
requirements.quote: the appropriate specialty section of the board determines, pursuant to rules it adopts, that the requirements for registration, licensure, or certification under the laws of the other state are substantially equal to the requirements for licensure in this state and that the other state extends similar reciprocity to persons licensed under this chapter

state_preempts_local_registration_fees.quote: No political subdivision, district, or agency of the state may adopt an ordinance or rule that requires contractor registration and the assessment of a registration or license fee unless that ordinance or rule also requires any contractor who registers and pays the registration or license fee to be licensed in the contractor's trade pursuant to this chapter.

local_trade_licensing_preserved.quote: nothing in this chapter shall be construed to limit the operation of any statute or rule of this state or any ordinance or rule of any political subdivision, district, or agency of the state that does either of the following: (1) Regulates the installation, repair, maintenance, or alteration of plumbing systems, hydronics systems, electrical systems, heating, ventilating, and air conditioning systems, or refrigeration systems
